snippet.title: "Crescent Tower: RISING" Steam Release Confirmed by AMATA Games!
snippet.description:
―A legacy of bravery births hope anew― 
Featuring retro graphics and sound that will take you back to the 80s. 
 Nostalgic, yet new—venture into the 8-bit style RPG, "Crescent Tower: RISING" 
✨Steam Release Confirmed! ✨
